text.en: 1. This Notification is the Multimodal Transport (Singapore Competent National Body) Notification 2021.
2. The Minister authorises the Land Transport Authority of Singapore as the competent national body of Singapore, for the purposes of the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Multimodal Transport.
